story.originalTitle: Who slept best last night: Kimi Antonelli
story.summaryEn: Antonelli has won the F1 world championship, becoming the youngest champion in history and beating the previous record by more than three years. In only his second F1 season he took the title with an almost perfect campaign, while Verstappen and Hamilton lost even a mathematical chance with four rounds still to go.
detailZh: 昨晚谁睡得最好：安东内利
一个人人都喜欢的孩子赢得了世界冠军
当你试图消化安东内利的这个冠军时，该从哪里说起？又该说些什么？也许先从数字说起。这场胜利是历史性的。他不仅是最年轻的F1世界冠军，还把此前的纪录提前了三年多。他在F1的第二个赛季就以近乎完美的表现做到了这一点。而此时此刻，他在积分榜上领先的是两位多次世界冠军、本身也是世代级天才的维斯塔潘和汉密尔顿，两人在还剩四站时就已经失去了挑战他的数学可能。
你必须谈论一种不可思议的天赋。年仅20岁、赛车经验仅约五年，仅凭这份非凡天赋就足以带来一个冠军——尽管一切都表明他仍有很大的成长空间。对任何如此年轻的人来说，必然如此。
不可避免的，人们也会谈论赛车本身，但没有人能否认这些数字。只需看一眼墨西哥大奖赛后的积分榜，就能明白这不仅仅是梅赛德斯的功劳——是安东内利在创造差异。
还有他对赛车和生活的态度。他对自己的热爱有多么投入，他对自己有多么严格地要求，以及他如何在围场之外保持一个普通孩子的样子。
然后是她的性格。善良、谦逊、有礼、慷慨、尊重他人。基米·安东内利是每个车队领队都梦寐以求的车手——也是每个父母都梦想拥有的儿子。在当今疯狂的世界里，这是一个关于如何在实现一切目标的同时保持所有这些品质的故事——这是一个美妙而暖心的故事。你就是忍不住喜欢他——以及他做事的方式。
但这不仅仅是一个关于天赋的故事。这也是一个关于如何让天赋闪耀的故事。
毕竟，拥有天赋是一种恩赐。而发现天赋并让它绽放，则是一种本领。
而且你得佩服托托·沃尔夫：他向所有人展示了该怎么做。他和整个梅赛德斯车队不仅发现了安东内利，还如此迅速、如此出色地将其转化为成功——这堪称培养人才的教科书式范例。
这应该在管理学院里讲授。这应该成为一个案例研究——以及为那些渴望成为领导者的人提供的一份行动指南。

没有理由再把这一切重述一遍，但确实有足够多的时刻，沃尔夫本可以犹豫，或让疑虑占据上风。安东内利艰难的国际汽联二级方程式赛季。那次蒙扎撞车。去年年中那段可怕的时期——以及随后媒体上的风暴。这些只是我们看到的时刻。可能还有更多我们不知道的。然而沃尔夫和他的团队始终秉持一个原则穿越了这一切：他们支持他，他们力挺他，他们继续相信他——因为他们知道自己拥有什么。他们全力以赴。而他也完全回报了这份信任。毫无疑问，他还会带来更多。
比赛结束几分钟后，托托的副手布拉德利·洛德被递上麦克风接受F1电视台采访时，谈的正是这件事。
“刘易斯告诉我们他要离开的那天，托托走进办公室，还有基米，我们打电话给基米说，你能来工厂吗？”他回忆道。“他碰巧在银石赛道测试。我们坐在托托的办公室里，托托告诉他，‘可能是你’。这是刘易斯带来的消息。‘可能是你，基米’。
安德烈亚·基米·安东内利，梅赛德斯，托托·沃尔夫，梅赛德斯
“而托托从第一秒起就相信这一点，从有机会把他放进车里的那一刻起，他就相信我们会做到这件事，而且会成功。”
“而那份信念支撑我们度过了艰难时刻。所以这首先是基米的成功。但同样，是的，正如我所说，这要追溯到最高层，追溯到托托的决心和信念——我们拥有一颗钻石，需要稍加打磨，但我们拥有一颗钻石。
“而今天证明了这是真的。”
他们为他配备了合适的人。当然，最值得一提的是彼得·邦宁顿。我们可能永远无法知道博诺本人追随汉密尔顿——那个与他共同取得如此多成就的人——去追寻红色梦想的诱惑有多大。是否有过他想离开的时刻？也许没有。但将打磨那颗钻石的任务托付给他，以及托付给车手周围的整个团队，是沃尔夫的又一妙招。因为他们不仅帮助安东内利成长，还设法让他享受其中——而不是在压力下崩溃。
“我的意思是，基米正在与这项运动有史以来最成功的比赛工程师合作，”布拉德利说。“所以博诺是一位令人难以置信的、冷静的、有引导力的人物。”
“而他会第一个说，在基米身边，他只是一个冰山一角，身边有斯特凡、马塞洛——性能工程师、控制工程师，有负责动力单元方面的乔治奥斯，有负责他所有日程安排的丹尼，索菲亚负责差旅，罗莎负责公关，塞尔吉是他的教练。我们建立并组建了一整个团队和一整个圈子。”
“而结果就是一个热爱生活的年轻人，你知道，是的，他应对着F1的压力，但并没有被压垮，能够享受其中。”
“而且我喜欢[看到]巴库之后，有很多议论，这是不是他崩溃的时刻？他飞往马来西亚，和塞尔吉一起去了水上乐园。这就是你需要了解的关于基米的一切。你知道，他20岁，正过着最美好的生活。这就是我们想让他拥有的。就享受这段旅程，享受这场冒险，让天赋自然流淌。”
而正是布拉德利本人，与罗莎·埃雷罗·贝内加斯、亚当·麦克戴德以及梅赛德斯传播团队的许多其他人一起，在保护安东内利免受媒体审视、让他适应外界压力方面发挥了作用。而我们这些另一边的人——记者们——常常因请求被拒而感到沮丧，尤其是在早期，但他们清楚地知道自己在做什么。
因为沃尔夫不仅仅是自己相信安东内利的天赋——他还确保整个车队都相信。
“我的意思是，是的，这从最高层开始，从托托开始，”洛德说。“从奥拉[康林松，梅赛德斯-奔驰集团首席执行官]和斯图加特的所有董事会成员开始，然后贯穿詹姆斯[艾利森]和他的技术团队、肖[安德鲁·肖夫林]和罗恩[梅多斯]、维修区墙上的那些人、布里克斯沃斯的[达伦]豪厄尔以及HPP所有出色的工程师们。而且，你知道，自从我们上次赢得冠军以来，这支车队超过一半的人是2021年之后新加入的。
“所以我们经历了一个巨大的变革时期，新的、新鲜的血液、新鲜的想法、新鲜的人才加入进来。经历一段困难时期然后反弹回到顶峰也是非常非常特别的。但这一切都从最高层开始，从托托和他令人难以置信的领导力以及他绝对拒绝不赢的态度开始。
“他不断推动我们，他如此用力地推动每个人，但这就是结果，这是值得的。”
梅赛德斯不仅需要发现安东内利的天赋、培养它、打磨它，并帮助它在通往2020年以来首个车手总冠军的道路上绽放。它还需要在上一版技术规则下的艰难时期之后重塑自我——而这一路走来究竟做出了多少正确的决定，只有内部人士才知道。这无疑也需要培养和激发数百位其他优秀人才的最佳状态，即便安东内利的案例是最为人所见的。
但这也反映了沃尔夫和他的团队在重返巅峰之路上成功建立的文化。如今发生的一切，最终证明了你可以通过信任你所相信的人——并给予他们交付所需的一切——来创造属于自己的成功。
真的，除此之外没什么可说的了。除了祝贺——以及干得漂亮。
detailEn: Who slept best last night: Kimi Antonelli
A kid everyone likes has won the world championship

Where do you start when trying to digest Kimi Antonelli's championship? What do you say about it? Perhaps start with the numbers. This victory is historic. He's not just the youngest to win the F1 title; he's beaten the previous record by more than three years. He's done it with an almost perfect season, just his second in F1. And right now, at this very moment, he's ahead in the championship of two multiple world champions and generational talents themselves, Max Verstappen and Lewis Hamilton, both of whom have lost even a mathematical chance of challenging him with four rounds still to go.

You've got to talk about an incredible talent. At 20 years of age, and with barely five years of experience racing cars, that exceptional talent alone was enough to deliver a championship victory - even though everything suggests there's still plenty of room for growth. There just has to be, as with anyone so young.

Inevitably, there will be talk about the car as well, but no one can deny the numbers. A brief look at the standings after the Mexico Grand Prix is enough to understand that it's not just Mercedes - it's Antonelli making the difference.
There's his attitude to racing and life, too. How dedicated he is to his passion, how rigorously he works on himself, and how he manages to remain a normal kid outside the paddock.

And then there's his personality. Kind, humble, polite, generous, respectful of others. Kimi Antonelli is a racer every team principal would kill to have - and a son every parent would dream of having. In today's insane world, it's a story about how you can achieve everything you want while remaining all those things - and it's a fantastic, heartwarming story. You just can't help liking him - and the way he goes about things.
But it's not just a story about talent. It's also a story about how you make that talent shine.
Having talent is a gift, after all. Spotting it and making it flourish is a skill.

And you've got to hand it to Toto Wolff: he's shown everyone how it's done. The way he and the whole Mercedes team managed not only to spot Antonelli, but to turn it into success - so quickly and so brilliantly - is a textbook example of how you nurture talent.
It should be taught in management schools. It should be a case study - and a playbook for those aspiring to be leaders.

There's no reason to go over it all again, but there have been enough moments when Wolff could have hesitated or let doubts take over. Antonelli's difficult F2 campaign. That Monza crash. That horrendous middle part of last year - and the subsequent storm in the media. Those are just the moments we've seen. There are probably more we don't know about. Yet Wolff and his team navigated through all of it with one principle in mind: they backed him, they supported him, they continued to believe in him - because they knew what they had. They committed. And he has repaid that faith in full. There's no doubt he'll deliver more.
When, minutes after the race had finished, Toto's deputy Bradley Lord was handed a microphone for an F1 TV interview, that's exactly what he talked about.

"The day Lewis told us he was leaving, Toto came into the office and Kimi, and we phoned Kimi and said, can you come to the factory?" he recalled. "He happened to be at Silverstone, testing. And we sat in Toto's office and Toto told him, 'it could be you'. Here's this news from Lewis. 'This could be you, Kimi'.
Andrea Kimi Antonelli, Mercedes, Toto Wolff, Mercedes
"And Toto has believed that from the first second, from the very first moment that the opportunity came to put him in a car, he has believed we will do this and it will be a success.

"And that conviction has carried us through the difficult moments. And so this is Kimi's success first and foremost. But also, yeah, as I said, it goes back to the top and it goes back to Toto's determination and belief that we had a little, we had a diamond that we needed to polish a little bit, but we had a diamond.
"And today shows that's true."

They surrounded him with the right people. Most notably Peter Bonnington, of course. We'll probably never know how serious the temptation was for Bono himself to follow Hamilton - the man he'd achieved so much with - and pursue the dream in red. Was there a moment when he thought about leaving? Maybe there wasn't. But entrusting the task of polishing that diamond to him, and to the whole group around the driver, was another great move by Wolff. Because they didn't just help Antonelli grow. They managed to keep him enjoying himself - and not crumbling under pressure.
"I mean, Kimi's working with the most successful race engineer this sport has ever seen," Bradley said. "So Bono's an incredible, calm, guiding character.

"And he would be the first to say he's the tip of an iceberg around Kimi with Stephane, with Marcelo, the performance engineer, controls engineer, with Georgios on the PU side, with Danny, who does all his scheduling, Sofia doing the travel, Rosa doing the PR, Sergi is his coach. There's a whole group and a whole bubble that we've built and put together.
"And the result is a young man who is just loving life and, you know, yes, dealing with the pressure of F1, but not overwhelmed by it and able to enjoy himself.

"And I loved [seeing] after Baku, there was a lot of talk, is this the moment where he crumbles? He flew to Malaysia and went to a water park with Sergi. And that's all you need to know about Kimi. You know, he's 20 and he's living his best life. And that's what we wanted for him. Just enjoy the ride, enjoy the adventure, let the talent flow."

And it's Bradley himself, together with Rosa Herrero Venegas, Adam McDaid and many others from the Mercedes communications team, who played their part in shielding Antonelli from media scrutiny and making him comfortable with the pressure of the outside world. And while those of us on the other side - the journalists - were often left frustrated by denied requests, especially early on, they knew exactly what they were doing.
Because Wolff didn't just believe in Antonelli's talent himself - he made sure the whole team did, too.

"I mean, yeah, it starts from the top and it starts from Toto," Lord said. "It starts from Ola [Källenius, CEO of Mercedes-Benz Group] and all the board in Stuttgart and it goes through James [Allison] and his technical team, Show [Andrew Shovlin] and Ron [Meadows], the guys on the pit wall, [Darren] Howell in Brixworth and all the amazing engineers at HPP as well. And, you know, since we last won a championship, this team is over half the people are new since 2021.

"So we've had a huge period of change, new, fresh blood, fresh ideas, fresh talent come in. And it's very, very special to have a difficult period and then bounce back to the top as well. But it all starts from the top and from Toto and his incredible leadership and his absolute refusal to not win.
"And he keeps pushing us and he pushes everybody so hard, but this is the result and it's worth it."

Mercedes didn't just need to spot Antonelli's talent, nurture it, polish it and help it flourish on the way to its first drivers' title since 2020. It needed to reinvent itself after a difficult spell under the previous regulations - and the true number of right decisions made along the way is known only to those on the inside. That surely required nurturing and bringing out the best in hundreds of other talented people, too, even if Antonelli's case is the most visible.

But it's also a reflection of the culture Wolff and his team have managed to build on their way back to the top. What has happened now is the ultimate proof of how you can create your own success by trusting those you believe in - and giving them everything they need to deliver.
And there's nothing more to say, really. Apart from congratulations - and well done.

detailZh: 梅赛德斯技术总监警告，F1车队不会对2027年下压力削减坐视不管
梅赛德斯技术总监詹姆斯·艾利森警告，F1工程师将对国际汽联2027年的下压力削减予以反击
致梅赛德斯车迷。来自银箭的最新消息，包括F1新闻、车手动态、赛车研发以及来自布拉克利和布里克斯沃思的赛事分析。
F1向2026年新动力单元与底盘规则的过渡彻底打乱了竞争格局，但规则手册远未最终确定。随着车队为2027年新规下的第二个赛季做准备，国际汽联正推动再次强制降低下压力。
早期报告表明，管理机构的目标是在2027赛季将下压力减少20至50个点。为了实现这一目标，国际汽联计划禁止若干关键的后部空气动力学部件，以改善混合动力能量管理，并减少阻碍赛车紧密跟车的湍流“脏空气”。
但梅赛德斯技术总监詹姆斯·艾利森最近警告说，制定规则来减慢一级方程式赛车的速度，很少能阻止围场顶尖工程师找到绕过它的办法。
在NU Silver Arrows Radio Show播客节目中，艾利森确认了国际汽联拟议的空气动力学限制范围，同时向即将到来的研发战发出了挑战。
“我所知道的是，新规则会让赛车损失一些下压力，不止一点，”艾利森解释道。
乔治·拉塞尔，梅赛德斯车队；安德烈亚·基米·安东内利，梅赛德斯车队
从历史上看，国际汽联与一级方程式车队之间的关系始终是一场无休止的猫鼠游戏。管理机构出于安全和竞赛考量修改规则手册以限制过弯速度，而车队则立即在风洞中投入数百万美元，以恢复国际汽联试图削去的下压力。
据艾利森表示，2027年的规则周期也不会有任何不同。
“他们已经做出了不错的尝试，试图将下压力拉回到2026时代初期的水平，”艾利森指出。
他补充道：“看看各车队是会选择妥协接受，还是会全力夺回全部性能，这将非常有意思。”
如果梅赛德斯在2026年的巨大飞跃能说明什么，那就是阿利森在布拉克利的工程部门完全没有妥协的打算。2027赛季的技术战线已经正式划定。
detailEn: Mercedes technical director warns F1 teams won’t “lie down” over 2027 downforce cuts
Mercedes technical director James Allison warns F1 engineers will fight back against the FIA's 2027 downforce cuts
For Mercedes fans. All the latest from the Silver Arrows, with F1 news, driver updates, car development and race analysis from Brackley and Brixworth.

Formula 1's transition to the new 2026 engine and chassis regulations completely reshuffled the competitive order, but the rulebook is far from finalised. As teams prepare for their second year under the new formula in 2027, the FIA is pushing to mandate another drop in downforce.

Early reports indicate the governing body is targeting a reduction of 20 to 50 points of downforce for the 2027 season. To achieve this, the FIA plans to ban several key rear aerodynamic elements in a bid to improve hybrid energy management and reduce the turbulent "dirty air" that prevents cars from following each other closely.
But Mercedes technical director James Allison recently cautioned that writing a rule to slow down a Formula 1 car rarely stops the grid's top engineers from finding a way around it.

Speaking on the NU Silver Arrows Radio Show podcast, Allison confirmed the scope of the FIA's proposed aerodynamic restrictions while simultaneously throwing down the gauntlet for the upcoming development war.
"All I know is that the cars are going to be losing a bit of downforce from the new regs, more than a bit," Allison explained.
George Russell, Mercedes, Andrea Kimi Antonelli, Mercedes

Historically, the relationship between the FIA and Formula 1 constructors is a perpetual game of cat and mouse. The governing body alters the rulebook to limit cornering speeds on safety and racing grounds, and the teams immediately spend millions of dollars in the wind tunnel to recover the exact downforce the FIA attempted to take away.
According to Allison, the 2027 regulation cycle will be no different.
"They've had a good go at trying to pull the downforce back to [the] start of the 2026 era," Allison noted.
"It'll be interesting to see whether the teams lie down and take that or whether we recover it all or not," he added.

If Mercedes' massive leap forward in 2026 is any indication, Allison's engineering department in Brackley has zero intention of lying down. The technical battle lines for the 2027 season have officially been drawn.

relatedItems.originalTitle: Mercedes and Audi unveil adidas collections for F1 Las Vegas Grand Prix
detailZh: 梅赛德斯-奔驰和奥迪在F1拉斯维加斯大奖赛上推出阿迪达斯系列
梅赛德斯-奔驰霓虹灯和奥迪夜场系列现已通过adidas.com购买
拉斯维加斯欢迎标志上空出现彩虹
赛车文化超越赛道。车手生活方式、时尚、旅行、设计和让赛车不仅仅是一项运动的故事。
梅赛德斯-奔驰和奥迪为即将到来的Formula 1拉斯维加斯大奖赛推出了特别的阿迪达斯粉丝系列。
梅赛德斯-奔驰的系列名为"霓虹灯"，而奥迪的系列名为"深夜"。这两个系列现在已在adidas.com上上市，品牌美国店内的单品价格从30美元到200美元不等。
最贵的产品是外套。梅赛德斯-奔驰的拉斯维加斯夹克和奥迪的拉斯维加斯轰炸机夹克都售价200美元。
梅赛德斯-奔驰的系列比奥迪的大。除了夹克，它还包括120美元的卫衣、95美元的长袖T恤、60美元的短裤、55美元的车手帽、50美元的比赛帽和40美元及45美元的T恤。
奥迪车队的阵容有55美元的车手上限，两件各45美元的图形T恤和一件30美元的包。
两支车队抵达拉斯维加斯时的位置截然不同。梅赛德斯在巴西大奖赛上锁定了2026年 constructors' championship。奥迪在接管萨博后作为一支工厂车队的第一赛季，目前排名第八，积28分。这家德国车队落后哈斯三分。
梅赛德斯车队的基米·安东内利在墨西哥大奖赛中赢得了车手冠军，成为F1历史上最年轻的冠军。他的队友乔治·拉塞尔目前正在争夺亚军，目前排名第三，落后红牛的马克斯·维斯塔潘。
奥迪的加布里埃尔·博尔特洛托和尼科·胡肯伯格目前在车手积分榜上分别排名第14和第15，两人都积14分。
拉斯维加斯大奖赛将于11月19日至21日举行，是赛季最后三轮比赛中的第一轮，紧接着是卡塔尔和阿布扎比。
detailEn: Mercedes and Audi unveil adidas collections for F1 Las Vegas Grand Prix
The Mercedes Neon Lights and Audi After Hours collections are available now through adidas.com
A rainbow above the Welcome to Las Vegas sign
Motorsport culture beyond the track. Driver lifestyle, fashion, travel, design and the stories that make racing more than a sport.
Mercedes and Audi have unveiled special adidas fan collections for the upcoming Formula 1 Las Vegas Grand Prix.

Mercedes' range is called "Neon Lights", while Audi's is named "After Hours". Both collections are available now through adidas.com, and the pieces listed on the brand's US store range in price from $30 to $200.
The most expensive items are the outerwear. Mercedes' Las Vegas jacket and Audi's Las Vegas bomber jacket both cost $200.
The Mercedes collection is the bigger of the two. Alongside the jacket, it includes a $120 hoodie, a $95 long-sleeve T-shirt, $60 shorts, a $55 driver cap, a $50 race cap and T-shirts at $40 and $45.
Audi's line-up has a $55 driver cap, two graphic T-shirts at $45 each and a $30 bag.

The two teams arrive in Las Vegas in very different positions. Mercedes secured the 2026 constructors' championship at the Brazilian Grand Prix. Audi, in its first season as a works team after taking over Sauber, currently sits eighth in the standings with 28 points. The German outfit is three points behind Haas.

Mercedes' Kimi Antonelli claimed the drivers' title at the Mexican Grand Prix, becoming the youngest champion in the history of F1. His team-mate George Russell is currently in the fight for second in the championship, sitting third behind Red Bull's Max Verstappen.
Audi's Gabriel Bortoleto and Nico Hulkenberg currently sit 14th and 15th in the drivers' standings, both on 14 points.
The Las Vegas Grand Prix takes place from 19 to 21 November and is the first of the final three rounds of the season, ahead of Qatar and Abu Dhabi.

relatedItems.originalTitle: Max Verstappen signs ambassador deal with Dutch technical group VDK
relatedItems.summaryEn: Four-time Formula 1 world champion Max Verstappen has become the new ambassador of the VDK Group, a Dutch group of installation and technical companies, and will feature in its communications and marketing campaigns over the coming years.
detailZh: 马克斯·维斯塔潘与荷兰技术集团VDK签任大使协议
这位红牛车手将在未来数年参与VDK的传播与营销活动
致红牛车迷。关注红牛车队，获取来自米尔顿凯恩斯的F1新闻、车手动态、技术洞察与比赛分析。
四届F1世界冠军马克斯·维斯塔潘成为荷兰安装与技术企业集团VDK Group的新任大使，该集团正在向欧洲扩张。
这位荷兰车手将在未来几年在该公司的国际品牌推广中发挥重要作用，并将出现在其传播和营销活动中。
VDK 成立于 2013 年，是一家荷兰技术公司集团，如今在荷兰、德国、瑞典、奥地利、瑞士和比利时都有业务。
维斯塔潘表示，他认为 VDK 的组织方式与 F1 车队的运作方式有相似之处。
“VDK 的世界与一级方程式赛车之间有很多相似之处，”这位红牛车手说道。“技术发挥着巨大作用，但任何关注这项运动的人都知道，只有整个团队都达到顶尖水平，你才能发挥出最佳表现。”
在一支一级方程式车队里，每天都有大量的人在工作，让一切变得更好、更快。每个人都有自己的专业领域和职责。我在VDK的运作方式中看到了这一点。
它由许多技术公司和专业人士组成，他们各有专长，但团结在一起就更强大。VDK是一家创新型公司，也有着远大的国际雄心。我很高兴能在未来几年成为其中一员。
VDK创始人兼首席执行官弗兰斯·范德科尔克表示，这位荷兰人是公司下一步发展的理想人选。
“马克斯·维斯塔潘加入VDK集团让我无比自豪，”范德科尔克说。“马克斯多年来一直是世界上最顶尖的车手之一。但同样吸引我的是这背后的一切。仅靠天赋永远不够。你需要身边有优秀的人、相互信任、技术专长，以及每天变得更好的动力。这正是我在VDK集团所看到的。”
“我们通过整合实力雄厚的本地家族企业，并给予创业者自由发展的空间来实现增长。这一基础不会改变。与此同时，我们正日益将目光投向国门之外。”
“随着在荷兰、德国、瑞典、奥地利、瑞士和比利时拥有公司，我们正在形成一个日益国际化的集团。马克斯·维斯塔潘闻名世界，同时也体现了那种令人熟悉的荷兰务实态度和赢家心态。说实话，我无法想象还有谁比他更能代表我们希望带领VDK前进的方向。”
过去两年一直与VDK合作的前F1车手罗伯特·杜恩博斯将继续担任大使和演讲嘉宾。根据公告，他在协调与维斯塔潘的合作关系中发挥了关键作用。
“我非常高兴能与弗兰斯和VDK集团合作，”杜恩博斯解释道。“我们已经共同取得了伟大的成就，我也真正了解了VDK背后的人。如今我还能为这一下一步贡献力量，这让一切更加特别。”
“有了马克斯，VDK 集团当然就引进了一位真正独一档的人物。我很高兴我们现在为 VDK 集团携手合作，也非常期待未来的岁月。”
detailEn: Max Verstappen signs ambassador deal with Dutch technical group VDK
The Red Bull driver will feature in VDK’s communications and marketing campaigns over the coming years
For Red Bull fans. Keeping watch on Red Bull Racing, with F1 news, driver updates, technical insight and race analysis from Milton Keynes.
Four-time Formula 1 champion Max Verstappen has become the new ambassador of the VDK Group, a Dutch group of installation and technical companies that is expanding across Europe.
The Dutchman will play a prominent role in the company's international branding over the coming years and will feature in its communications and marketing campaigns.
VDK was founded in 2013 as a Dutch group of technical companies and now has businesses in the Netherlands, Germany, Sweden, Austria, Switzerland and Belgium.
Verstappen said he saw parallels between the way VDK is organised and the way an F1 team works.

"There are many similarities between the world of VDK and Formula 1," the Red Bull driver said. "Technology plays a huge role, but anyone who follows the sport knows that you can only perform at your best if the entire team is top-notch.

"In a Formula 1 team, a huge number of people work every day to make everything better and faster. Everyone has their own area of specialisation and responsibility. I recognise that in the way VDK operates.

"It’s a group of many technical companies and professionals who all have their own expertise but are stronger together. VDK is an innovative company and also has major international ambitions. I’m excited to be a part of that in the coming years."
VDK founder and chief executive Frans van der Kolk said the Dutchman was the ideal fit for the company's next step.

"The fact that Max Verstappen is joining the VDK Group makes me incredibly proud," van der Kolk said. "Max has been among the absolute world’s best for years. But what appeals to me just as much is what lies behind that. Talent alone is never enough. You need good people around you, mutual trust, technical expertise, and the drive to get better every day. That’s exactly what I see in the VDK Group.

"We’ve grown by bringing together strong local and family-owned businesses and giving entrepreneurs the freedom to thrive. That foundation won’t change. At the same time, we’re looking beyond our borders with increasing focus.

"With companies in the Netherlands, Germany, Sweden, Austria, Switzerland, and Belgium, we’re forming an increasingly international group. Max Verstappen is known worldwide and, at the same time, embodies that recognisable Dutch down-to-earth attitude and winner’s mentality. To be honest, I can’t imagine a stronger face to represent where we want to take VDK."

Former F1 driver Robert Doornbos, who has worked with VDK for the past two years, will stay on as an ambassador and speaker. According to the announcement, he played a key role in coordinating the partnership with Verstappen.

"I am very pleased with the collaboration with Frans and the VDK Group," Doornbos explained. "We’ve already achieved great things together, and I’ve really gotten to know the people behind VDK. The fact that I’ve now also been able to contribute to this next step makes it even more special.

"With Max, the VDK Group is, of course, bringing in someone who is truly in a league of his own. I’m happy that we’re now working together for the VDK Group and am really looking forward to the years ahead."
